name: Magic Cube (MFKZQ01LM) — Gesture Parser
info: Wire the output of your zigbee2mqtt-in node (node-red-contrib-zigbee2mqtt) for the cube into the Function node below. Also safe to wire a manually-triggered zigbee2mqtt "get" node's response into the same input. Output 1 = normalized gesture events (only on genuinely new gestures, fingerprint-based dedup). Output 2 = heartbeat/status reports (battery, voltage, link quality) with no new gesture. Output 3 = snapshot responses from a "get" request (msg.payload_in present) -- the cube's current cached state, not a live event. See magic-cube-gesture-reference.md for the full field/behavior notes.

name: Parse Magic Cube Gesture
